{{Quote|They risked everything on the success of of their human replica series. Customers didn't take to them, and LeisureMech went under.|[[Den Dhur]]|<ref name="The Last Jedi (novel)">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>}}
The '''BB-4000''' was a [[Human replica droid]] model that was produced by [[LeisureMech Enterprises/Legends|LeisureMech Enterprises]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. LeisureMech risked their entire enterprise on the success of the line, but the [[Human/Legends|Human]] replica [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were a commercial failure and as a result, the company went under. LeisureMech sold off their remaining stock and the [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawan]] resistance leader [[Degan Cor]] acquired two non-functional BB-4000 droids at a lower price. The droid were taken to be stored within the resistance base [[Mountain Home]] on Toprawa and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|mech-tech]] [[Geri]] later repaired one of the units, so that it could house the [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[I-5YQ]].
